patterns.name: keyword.control.block.dgm

patterns.comment: `from` in a view declaration, and the verbs a click binding can take.
patterns.name: keyword.other.dgm

patterns.comment: Actions. The list mirrors actionSpecs in pkg/parser/scenario.go — a new action added there needs adding here, which is the one place this grammar has to keep up with the language.
patterns.name: support.function.action.dgm

patterns.comment: Mermaid diagram openers and structure. Deliberately shallow: the diagram body round-trips verbatim through the emitter, and colouring it in depth would be a second Mermaid implementation to keep in step. `stateDiagram-v2` precedes `stateDiagram` so the longer spelling wins, and `state` refuses a following colon so that a `state: waiting` attribute on its own line stays an attribute. Lowercase `note` is deliberately absent: it would out-anchor the `note` action, which this grammar colours as an action everywhere.
patterns.name: keyword.control.diagram.dgm

patterns.comment: A link, in any of the forms pkg/parser/link.go recognises.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.link.dgm

patterns.comment: A node declaration's label, in whichever bracket pair gives it its shape.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.label.dgm

patterns.comment: An attribute name, up to its colon. Matching the shape rather than a fixed list keeps a new attribute from looking like a mistake before this file catches up.
